title: Kinetic workload batcher recommendation pipeline: multivariate profiling, heuristics, and safe continuous applies
creator: Amina Cortez
description:
Goal: Deliver a production-ready recommendation pipeline (batcher-advisor) that proposes batching + KV cache configurations per workload cohort based on continuous profiling signals, applies changes safely with staged rollout and automated rollback, and prioritizes latency SLO preservation and cost reduction.

Background: We already have instrumentation for request timing, tokenizer length, and KV cache hits, but lack a coherent, continuously-running engine that: (1) synthesizes a multivariate fingerprint per workload; (2) produces ranked config recommendations with a confidence score and risk estimate; (3) executes safe, incremental apply/rollback with observability hooks. Existing tickets focus on profiling agents and heuristics but are fragmented. This ticket packages the engine, safety gating, and rollout automation.

Scope: Build the recommendation pipeline components: collector -> profiler -> scorer -> suggestion store -> apply controller. Ship a shadow-mode run for 2 weeks, then opt-in gradual apply for low-risk cohorts. Provide dashboards and alerts for regression detection.

Out of scope: model quantization recommendations, per-customer billing changes, or complex multi-tenant autoscaling policies (handled separately).

Deliverables:
- New telemetry stream (batch_recommender.v1) and fingerprint schema.
- Heuristics library implementing tail-aware windowing, entropy-normalized fingerprints, and KV-window awareness.
- Confidence & risk estimator that outputs: recommended_batch_size, max_latency_delta_ms, expected_token_cost_pct_reduction, confidence_score (0..1), safety_reason_tags.
- Apply controller with shadow mode, staged canary apply, automatic rollback on SLA breaches, and an audit log entry per apply.
- Dashboard and runbook with KPIs and manual override UI in Console.
acceptance_criteria: Profiler produces a stable fingerprint for a workload cohort within 3 hours of sampling and persists to recommendations DB.
Recommendations include rationale fields: which signal moved (throughput/median latency/tail latency/KV-hit-rate) and numeric expected savings.
Apply controller supports: shadow (no-op), 5% canary, 25% ramp, 100% ramp, and automated rollback if latency P95 increases > 20% or error-rate increases by > 2x baseline.
Automated rollback completes within 2 minutes of detection and emits an audit record with the diff between old and new batch config.
End-to-end test harness simulates three workload archetypes (bursty, steady medium-length, long-sequence) and validates rollback triggers in CI.
Dashboard shows per-cohort: current recommendation, last-applied-config, recent experiment health, and expected monthly cost delta.

Implement collector agent to emit batch_recommender.v1 telemetry from runtime (sampling at request boundary, 1:100 sampling for high-volume routes). Owner: Marina.
Prototype heuristics library: tail-adaptive window, entropy-normalized similarity, hysteresis thresholds. Owner: Dev infra.
Build scorer that computes confidence_score and risk_estimate using historical rollback trace dataset. Owner: SRE ML.
Recommendation store + API (read/write with versioning & audit). Owner: Backend.
Apply controller: shadow, canary scheduler, rollback detector, snapshot/diff generator, and audit log writer. Owner: Tomas.

Create CI simulation tests for three workload archetypes and one failure scenario (KV-hit drop). Owner: QA.

implementation_notes: Fingerprinting: use exponential-weighted histograms for length and interarrival to react to recency while remaining robust. Store quantiles (p50/p75/p90/p95/p99) in recommendations DB.
Similarity scoring: cosine over a normalized feature vector with entropy term to avoid overconfident matches for low-variability cohorts.

Risk model: logistic regression trained on historical experiments (features: p95_delta_probability, kv_hit_change, burst_index). Output probability of rollback; calibrate to aim for <5% false-positive rollback on historical data.

Safety gates: (a) Max recommended_batch_size per GPU model family; (b) Hard cap on batch size growth per apply (no more than +50% of current); (c) Latency SLO guard with hysteresis of 3 consecutive windows before trigger.
Apply snapshot: capture current batch config, active kernel selection, and recent 15-minute latency/error histograms before any changes. Store snapshot UUID in audit log.

Rollback mechanism: apply controller watches for breach rules; on breach, it attempts a fast revert using stored snapshot, then re-evaluates for transient causes and tags the cohort as 'blocked' for 24h if revert fails twice.

Telemetry events: batch_recommendation.proposed, batch_recommendation.applied, batch_recommendation.rolled_back, batch_recommendation.shadow_result. Include correlation_id for tracing through request logs.
Economics: recommendation includes estimated monthly token cost delta and provides a confidence interval; use conservative median estimate for automatic applies, show optimistic upper bound in UI.
Data retention & privacy: keep fingerprints for 90 days; redact user identifiers. Use KMS for storing snapshots that include route identifiers in Private deployments.
CI: synthetic driver will replay recorded traces to simulate interarrival patterns and KV-hit dynamics; tests assert that rollback triggers when KV-hit drops by >30% during apply.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Local e2e + CI simulation (complete) -> smoke tests pass.
Phase 1 (Shadow, 2 weeks): Run in shadow mode for 30% of small/medium routes, no auto-apply. Collect health signals and refine risk thresholds.
Phase 2 (Canary, 1 week per cohort): 5% canary, monitor 1h windows, criteria: p95 <= baseline * 1.10, error_rate <= baseline * 1.5. If pass, ramp to 25% after 6h; if pass, ramp to 100% over 24h.
Phase 3 (Auto-apply opt-in): For cohorts with confidence_score >= 0.85 and expected cost reduction > 3%, enable auto-apply with full rollback automation.
Abort criteria: any cohort with >20% p95 increase sustained for 3 windows OR error-rate >2x baseline triggers immediate rollback and cohort blacklisting for 24h.
Post-mortem cadence: if a rollback occurs, initiate 3-day investigation with SRE, ML, and product.
metrics_kpis: Median per-token cost delta (per cohort) - goal: >= 3% reduction for auto-applies.
P95 latency change (absolute ms and percent) - goal: < 10% increase for canaries.
Shadow-to-apply precision: proportion of shadow recommendations that would have passed canary thresholds - target > 0.9.
Operator overrides per month - monitor for churn and lack of trust.
